description: Council appointed members to the Heritage Advisory Committee for 2026-2027.

chips.text: Brendan confirmed as chair, Randy as vice-chair for 2026.
13 public and organizational members appointed to the committee.

description: Brenda Southam appointed Chair of Municipal Heritage Advisory Committee.
Michelle Loi appointed Vice-Chair for 2026 term.
Committee deferred 2026 work plan discussion to next meeting.

chips.text: Staff noted full heritage conservation strategy funding was unsuccessful in 2025 budget.
Heritage property owners apply for awards, not held since 2018.
Why heritage awards received no applications in 2020 remains unclear.
Staff will circulate annual report and past heritage policy to new members.

description: Advisory Committee to review subcommittee needs.
Members will be appointed to subcommittees for 2026.
Committee to allocate its $17,900 budget for 2026.
Proposed rezoning 702/706 Victoria Avenue from R-N3 to R-N5.
Public hearing for St. John's Cathedral bylaw on February 25.
Public meeting for Victoria Avenue rezoning on January 27.

chips.text: The rezoning would allow a multiple unit dwelling up to six stories.

description: Council would receive updates from subcommittees.
